Class LinkedAccountsController

java.lang.Object
org.jwcarman.who.oidc.LinkedAccountsController
@RestController public class LinkedAccountsController extends Object
Lists and unlinks the caller's provider accounts: GET /who/me/accounts and DELETE /who/me/accounts/{id}. Starting a link (POST /who/me/accounts/{registrationId}) is LinkStartFilter's.

The list is for any signed-in caller, a key or a bearer token included, oldest first. provider is the client registration id whose issuer matches the account's, or the issuer itself when none does; linkedAt is when the account was first linked, read from its time-ordered id.

Unlinking is for a browser session only (an API key or bearer token, even beside the cookie, is 403), needs a recent sign-in, and runs through the LastCredentialGuard, so unlinking the last sign-in credential is 409. Only an account a configured registration signs in with counts toward that rule (see OidcSignInCredentialCounter); one whose registration was removed, or a JWT's issuer and subject, is unlinked without it. An account that does not exist and one that belongs to someone else are both 404. Unlinking the account the session signed in with is allowed and ends that session, which who re-resolves on every request.

      public LinkedAccountsController(SignInRegistrations registrations, FederatedCredentialService credentials, LastCredentialGuard guard, WhoSessionSecurityContextRepository sessions, Clock clock, Duration recentSignIn)
      Creates the controller.
      Parameters:
      registrations - names each account's provider
      credentials - lists and unlinks the caller's accounts
      guard - keeps an identity from losing its last sign-in credential
      sessions - tells a browser session from a key or token
      clock - the current time
      recentSignIn - how recently a browser session must have signed in to unlink an account
